description: 'Setup the F´ repository and tools'
inputs:
  location:
    required: true
    default: $GITHUB_WORKSPACE
runs:
  using: "composite"
  steps:
  - run: git fetch --tags
    shell: bash
  # Python path should be added at a higher level

    shell: bash
  - run: which fprime-gds
    shell: bash
  - run: which fpp-check
